acceptance_checks: With no grant, passing evaluations leave grant storage unchanged and publication blocked.
Evaluator and composer identities cannot invoke authorizer operations or manufacture approval by supplying role or approval fields.
Only exact matching artifact, bytes, destination, current policy, passing evaluation, and effective grant permit publication.
Expiry, revocation, and evaluation invalidation block later publication without deleting historical evidence.
Distinct unprivileged subprocesses cannot alter protected broker code, configuration, grant state, guard, or sink through filesystem access.
The receipt identifies the actual digest, destination, evaluation, grant, and policy; denied requests leave no partial publication.
Existing Proposed Move and Artifact schemas validate these work records, and the plan artifact digest matches its bytes.
The final evidence names exact tested source, command, environment, results, and remaining production and human-presence limits.
authority_required: Explicit authorization for local isolated enforcement verification
Separate human authorization for any future production publication
desired_change: Implement and verify a Linux broker that permits publication to a protected local sink only when current evaluation evidence and an independently recorded human-authorizer grant cover the same artifact, digest, destination, and policy.
expected_outcome: Evaluator and composer subprocesses cannot mint human grants, weaken the guard, or publish directly; actual evidence resolves only the tested local boundary.
hidden_context_dependencies: Existing runtime grant validation checks supplied fields; it does not authenticate the approval issuer or isolate grant storage.
A synthetic authorizer in automated tests proves operating-system identity separation, not actual human presence or consent.
resolution_note: Constrain: verified only for the exact recorded sources and Linux local protected-sink boundary, using synthetic authorizer identities. Actual human presence, production deployment, external publication, and Canon admission remain unproven; evaluation grants no authority.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: A weak boundary could turn evaluation into publication permission or permit unapproved bytes to reach the protected sink.

title: Enforce independent approval at exact digest publication
